declarations.name: RH.augDualResolvent.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (E : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (γ : ℝ),
  RH.augDualResolvent E v γ = (RH.dualZ E v γ)⁻¹

declarations.name: RH.augDualResolvent_fromBlocks
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] {E : Matrix n n ℝ} {v : n → ℝ} {γ : ℝ},
  (1 + E).PosDef →
    RH.shermanDenom E v γ ≠ 0 →
      RH.augDualResolvent E v γ =
        Matrix.fromBlocks
          (RH.dualResolvent E +
            RH.dualResolvent E * RH.borderCol v * RH.borderCorner (RH.shermanDenom E v γ)⁻¹ * RH.borderRow v *
              RH.dualResolvent E)
          (-(RH.dualResolvent E * RH.borderCol v * RH.borderCorner (RH.shermanDenom E v γ)⁻¹))
          (-(RH.borderCorner (RH.shermanDenom E v γ)⁻¹ * RH.borderRow v * RH.dualResolvent E))
          (RH.borderCorner (RH.shermanDenom E v γ)⁻¹)

declarations.name: RH.augDualResolvent_gt_half_iff_qDagger
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] {E : Matrix n n ℝ} {v : n → ℝ} {γ : ℝ},
  (RH.dualZ E v γ).PosDef →
    (1 - E).PosDef → ((RH.augDualResolvent E v γ - (1 / 2) • 1).PosDef ↔ 0 < 1 - RH.qDagger E v γ)

declarations.name: RH.augDualResolvent_gt_half_of_C_gt_one

  C.PosDef →
    (C - 1).PosDef →
      (RH.dualZ C⁻¹ v γ).PosDef → 0 < 1 - RH.qDagger C⁻¹ v γ → (RH.augDualResolvent C⁻¹ v γ - (1 / 2) • 1).PosDef

declarations.name: RH.augDualResolvent_gt_smul_implies_dualResolvent

declarations.name: RH.autocorrelation_integrand_abs_le

declarations.name: RH.autocorrelation_integrand_lip
declarations.type:

    (∀ (t : ℝ), t < a ∨ a + R < t → h t = 0) →
      0 ≤ R → ∀ (u x y : ℝ), |h x * h (x + u) - h y * h (y + u)| ≤ 2 * ↑K * ↑K * R * |x - y|

declarations.name: RH.autocorrelation_second_diff_eq
declarations.type:
∀ {h : ℝ → ℝ},
  Continuous h →
    HasCompactSupport h →
      ∀ (u δ : ℝ),
        ((∫ (t : ℝ), h t * h (t + u)) - 2 * ∫ (t : ℝ), h t * h (t + (u - δ))) + ∫ (t : ℝ), h t * h (t + (u - 2 * δ)) =
          -∫ (t : ℝ), (h t - h (t + -δ)) * (h (t + (u - δ)) - h (t + (u - 2 * δ)))

declarations.name: RH.autocorrelation_second_diff_le
declarations.type:
∀ {h : ℝ → ℝ} {K : NNReal} {a R : ℝ},
  Continuous h →
    HasCompactSupport h →
      LipschitzWith K h →
        (∀ (t : ℝ), t < a ∨ a + R < t → h t = 0) →
          0 ≤ R →
            ∀ (u δ : ℝ),
              |((∫ (t : ℝ), h t * h (t + u)) - 2 * ∫ (t : ℝ), h t * h (t + (u - δ))) +
                    ∫ (t : ℝ), h t * h (t + (u - 2 * δ))| ≤
                ↑K ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 * (R + 2 * |δ|)

declarations.name: RH.bin_partial_summation
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {w : ℝ → ℝ},

    ∀ (S : Finset α) (γ : α → ℝ) {C : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C →
        (∀ (k : ℤ), ↑{x ∈ S | ↑k < γ x ∧ γ x ≤ ↑k + 1}.card ≤ C) →
          ∀ {M : ℤ → ℝ},
            (∀ (k : ℤ), 0 ≤ M k) →
              (∀ (k : ℤ), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (↑k) (↑k + 1), w t ≤ M k) → Summable M → ∑ x ∈ S, w (γ x) ≤ C * ∑' (k : ℤ), M k

    ∀ (S : Finset α) (γ μ : α → ℝ),
      (∀ (x : α), 0 ≤ μ x) →
        ∀ (C : ℤ → ℝ),
          (∀ (k : ℤ), 0 ≤ C k) →
            (∀ (k : ℤ), {x ∈ S | ↑k < γ x ∧ γ x ≤ ↑k + 1}.sum μ ≤ C k) →
              ∀ {M : ℤ → ℝ},
                (∀ (k : ℤ), 0 ≤ M k) →
                  (∀ (k : ℤ), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (↑k) (↑k + 1), w t ≤ M k) →
                    (Summable fun k => C k * M k) → ∑ x ∈ S, μ x * w (γ x) ≤ ∑' (k : ℤ), C k * M k

            Summable M → ∑ q ∈ S, ↑(Z.mult q) * w q.2 ≤ ↑RH.gaborKBin * ∑' (k : ℤ), M k

declarations.type:

  RH.GaborConfigIncrementCompliantLog Z →
    Z.gammaDistinct →
      ∀ {a : ℝ},
        0 < a →
          a ≤ (RH.isolationShrinkOfConfig Z hZ).1 →
            RH.gaborHonestWeil a (RH.gaborIsolationOmega (RH.gaborHostSigma Z hZ) (RH.gaborHostGamma Z hZ) a) Z
                RH.gaborCInc ≤
              RH.gaborEnhancement (RH.gaborHostSigma Z hZ) a *
                  (-RH.gaborEtaTune (RH.gaborHostSigma Z hZ) a * ↑(RH.gaborHostMult Z hZ) +
                      RH.gaborTPlusLooseLog a
                        (RH.gaborIsolationOmega (RH.gaborHostSigma Z hZ) (RH.gaborHostGamma Z hZ) a) +
                    RH.gaborTFarLog a (RH.gaborIsolationOmega (RH.gaborHostSigma Z hZ) (RH.gaborHostGamma Z hZ) a)) +
                RH.gaborHonestOnlineBudget a
                  (RH.gaborIsolationOmega (RH.gaborHostSigma Z hZ) (RH.gaborHostGamma Z hZ) a) RH.gaborCInc

declarations.name: RH.gabor_horizontal_edges_along_landau
declarations.type:
∀ {F : RH.GaborWeilTest},
  F.coeffs = { c0 := 1, c2 := 0, c4 := 0 } →
    ∀ {T : ℕ → ℝ},
      (∀ (k : ℕ), ↑(2 * k + 3) ≤ T k ∧ T k ≤ ↑(2 * k + 3) + 1) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (ρ : ℂ),
            riemannZeta ρ = 0 → ρ ≠ 1 → 1 / (RH.ordinateGapConstLandau * (1 + Real.log (T k))) ≤ |ρ.im - T k|) →
          Filter.Tendsto
              (fun k =>
                ∫ (x : ℝ) in -1 / 16..2,
                  logDeriv riemannZeta (↑x + ↑(T k) * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑x + ↑(T k) * Complex.I))
              Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
            Filter.Tendsto
              (fun k =>
                ∫ (x : ℝ) in -1 / 16..2,
                  logDeriv riemannZeta (↑x + ↑(-T k) * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑x + ↑(-T k) * Complex.I))
              Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)

    D.IsHermitian →
      ∀ [Invertible A],
        (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.transpose D).IsHermitian →
          sigNeg (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.transpose D).toQuadraticMap' =
            sigNeg A.toQuadraticMap' + sigNeg (D - B.transpose * A⁻¹ * B).toQuadraticMap'

  [inst_3 : DecidableEq l] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (B : Matrix n l ℝ) (D : Matrix l l ℝ),
  A.IsHermitian →
    D.IsHermitian →
      ∀ [Invertible D],
        (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.transpose D).IsHermitian →
          sigNeg (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.transpose D).toQuadraticMap' =
            sigNeg (A - B * D⁻¹ * B.transpose).toQuadraticMap' + sigNeg D.toQuadraticMap'

declarations.type:

    ∀ {n : ℕ},

              RH.gaborHat F (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑τ * Complex.I) =
          2 * ↑Real.pi * ↑(ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) * ↑n ^ (-(1 / 2)) *

declarations.name: RH.logDeriv_riemannZeta_functional
declarations.type:
∀ {s : ℂ},
  2 ≤ |s.im| → riemannZeta s ≠ 0 → logDeriv riemannZeta s = -logDeriv riemannZeta (1 - s) - logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor s

declarations.name: RH.logDeriv_riemannZeta_functional_of_eventually

  ((fun w => riemannZeta (1 - w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 s] fun w => RH.zetaFEFactor w * riemannZeta w) →
    s ≠ 1 →
      1 - s ≠ 1 →
        (∀ (n : ℕ), s ≠ -↑n) →
          RH.zetaFEFactor s ≠ 0 →
            riemannZeta s ≠ 0 → logDeriv riemannZeta s = -logDeriv riemannZeta (1 - s) - logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor s

declarations.name: RH.logDeriv_zetaFEFactor
declarations.type:

  (∀ (n : ℕ), s ≠ -↑n) →
    Complex.cos (↑Real.pi * s / 2) ≠ 0 →
      logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor s =
        -Complex.log (2 * ↑Real.pi) + s.digamma - ↑Real.pi / 2 * Complex.tan (↑Real.pi * s / 2)

    -Complex.log ↑Real.pi + 1 / 2 * ((1 / 2 + ↑t * Complex.I) / 2).digamma +
      1 / 2 * ((1 - (1 / 2 + ↑t * Complex.I)) / 2).digamma

declarations.name: RH.logDeriv_zetaFEFactor_left_edge

declarations.name: RH.norm_P_shift_le
declarations.type:
∀ (p : RH.EvenQuartic) (a omega : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    ∀ (δ : ℂ),
      ‖RH.gaussianPolynomialFactor p a (δ + Complex.I * ↑omega)‖ ≤
        RH.gaussianPolynomialFactorBound p a * (1 + |δ.re| + |omega|) ^ 4 * (1 + |δ.im|) ^ 4

declarations.name: RH.norm_arch_horizontal_edge_le
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.GaborWeilTest) {σ₁ σ₂ τ B C c : ℝ},
  σ₁ ≤ σ₂ →
    0 ≤ B →
      0 ≤ C →
        0 ≤ c →
          (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, ‖logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor (↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤ B) →
            (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, ‖RH.gaborHat F (↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-c * τ ^ 2)) →
              2 ≤ |τ| →
                ‖∫ (x : ℝ) in σ₁..σ₂,
                      logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor (↑x + ↑τ * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑x + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤
                  (σ₂ - σ₁) * B * C * Real.exp (-c * τ ^ 2)

declarations.name: RH.norm_cexp_neg_frequency_mul_square
declarations.type:

  0 < a →
    ∀ (z : ℂ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-↑omega ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a)) * Complex.exp (z ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a))‖ =
        Real.exp ((z.re ^ 2 - z.im ^ 2 - omega ^ 2) / (2 * a))

declarations.name: RH.norm_cexp_square_shift
declarations.type:
∀ (a nu : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    ∀ (z : ℂ), ‖Complex.exp ((z + Complex.I * ↑nu) ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a))‖ = Real.exp ((z.re ^ 2 - (z.im + nu) ^ 2) / (2 * a))

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaborHat_le_poly_three_lobe
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.GaborWeilTest) (s : ℂ),
  ‖RH.gaborHat F s‖ ≤ RH.gaborHatQuarticThreeLobeConst F s.re * (1 + |s.im|) ^ 8 * RH.gaborThreeLobe F.a F.omega s.im

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaborHat_le_poly_three_lobe_of_not_pure
declarations.type:
∀ {F : RH.GaborWeilTest},
  F.coeffs ≠ { c0 := 1, c2 := 0, c4 := 0 } →
    ∀ (s : ℂ),
      ‖RH.gaborHat F s‖ ≤
        RH.gaborHatThreeLobeConst F.a s.re *
              (RH.gaussianPolynomialFactorBound F.coeffs F.a ^ 2 * (1 + |s.re - 1 / 2| + |F.omega|) ^ 8) *
            (1 + |s.im|) ^ 8 *
          RH.gaborThreeLobe F.a F.omega s.im

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaborHat_le_three_lobe
declarations.type:
∀ {F : RH.GaborWeilTest},
  F.coeffs = { c0 := 1, c2 := 0, c4 := 0 } →
    ∀ (s : ℂ), ‖RH.gaborHat F s‖ ≤ RH.gaborHatThreeLobeConst F.a s.re * RH.gaborThreeLobe F.a F.omega s.im

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaborHat_online_finset_le_logMajorant_of_summable
declarations.type:
∀ {F : RH.GaborWeilTest},
  F.coeffs = { c0 := 1, c2 := 0, c4 := 0 } →
    ∀ (S : Finset { z // RH.IsCriticalStripZetaZero z }),
      (∀ ρ ∈ S, (↑ρ).re = 1 / 2) →
        (Summable fun k => RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k * RH.gaussBinMax F.a F.omega k) →
          (Summable fun k => RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k * RH.gaussBinMax F.a (-F.omega) k) →
            (Summable fun k => RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k * RH.gaussBinMax F.a 0 k) →
              ∑ ρ ∈ S, ‖RH.gaborHat F ↑ρ‖ ≤
                RH.gaborHatThreeLobeConst F.a (1 / 2) * RH.gaborLogThreeLobeMajorant F.a F.omega

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaborHat_pure_le_score
declarations.type:
∀ {a omega : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a),
  0 ≤ omega →
    ∀ (τ : { z // RH.IsCriticalStripZetaZero z }),
      ‖RH.gaborHat (RH.pureGaborTest a omega ha) ↑τ‖ ≤
        Real.pi / a * Real.exp (RH.gaborScore (RH.stripSigma τ) (RH.stripGamma τ) omega / (2 * a))

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaborHat_pure_one_zero
declarations.type:
∀ (ha : 0 < 1) (s : ℂ),
  ‖RH.gaborHat (RH.pureGaborTest 1 0 ha) s‖ = Real.pi * Real.exp (((s.re - 1 / 2) ^ 2 - s.im ^ 2) / 2)

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaborHat_pure_one_zero_strip
declarations.type:
∀ (ha : 0 < 1) {s : ℂ},
  RH.IsCriticalStripZetaZero s →
    ‖RH.gaborHat (RH.pureGaborTest 1 0 ha) s‖ ≤ Real.pi * Real.exp (1 / 8) * Real.exp (-s.im ^ 2 / 2)

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaborLaplace_le
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.GaborWeilTest) (z : ℂ),
  ‖RH.gaborLaplace F z‖ ≤
    1 / 2 * √(Real.pi / F.a) *
      (Real.exp ((z.re ^ 2 - (z.im + F.omega) ^ 2) / (4 * F.a)) *
          ‖RH.gaussianPolynomialFactor F.coeffs F.a (z + Complex.I * ↑F.omega)‖ +
        Real.exp ((z.re ^ 2 - (z.im - F.omega) ^ 2) / (4 * F.a)) *
          ‖RH.gaussianPolynomialFactor F.coeffs F.a (z - Complex.I * ↑F.omega)‖)

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaborZeroSideHolomorphicTerm_le_box
declarations.type:
∀ {a0 a1 ω1 : ℝ},
  0 < a0 →
    ∀ {p : ℝ × ℝ},
      a0 ≤ p.1 →
        p.1 ≤ a1 →
          |p.2| ≤ ω1 →
            ∀ (ρ : { z // RH.IsCriticalStripZetaZero z }),
              ‖RH.gaborZeroSideHolomorphicTerm ρ p‖ ≤
                ↑(RH.riemannZetaMultiplicity ↑ρ) * RH.gaborZeroSideBoxC a0 ω1 * Real.exp (-(↑ρ).im ^ 2 / (4 * a1))

declarations.name: RH.norm_gabor_halfPrimeComb_term_le_LSeries
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.GaborWeilTest) (n : ℕ),
  ‖↑(ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) *
        if n = 0 then 0 else ↑n ^ (-(1 / 2)) * ↑(RH.pureGaborAutocorrelation F.a F.omega (Real.log ↑n))‖ ≤
    √(Real.pi / (2 * F.a)) / 2 * (1 + Real.exp (-F.omega ^ 2 / (2 * F.a))) * Real.exp (9 / (8 * F.a)) *
      ‖LSeries.term (fun n => ↑(ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n)) 2 n‖

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaussianLaplace_le
declarations.type:
∀ (p : RH.EvenQuartic) (a : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    ∀ (z : ℂ),
      ‖RH.gaussianLaplace p a z‖ ≤
        √(Real.pi / a) * Real.exp ((z.re ^ 2 - z.im ^ 2) / (4 * a)) * ‖RH.gaussianPolynomialFactor p a z‖

declarations.name: RH.norm_gaussianPolynomialFactor_le
declarations.type:
∀ (p : RH.EvenQuartic) (a : ℝ),
  0 < a → ∀ (z : ℂ), ‖RH.gaussianPolynomialFactor p a z‖ ≤ RH.gaussianPolynomialFactorBound p a * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ 4

declarations.name: RH.norm_hasDeriv_zetaFractCellIntegrand
declarations.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℂ) {x : ℝ},
  x ∈ Set.Icc (↑n + 1) (↑n + 2) → ‖-Complex.log ↑x * RH.zetaFractCellIntegrand n s x‖ ≤ Real.log x * x ^ (-s.re - 1)

declarations.name: RH.norm_horizontal_logDeriv_gaborHat_integral_le
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.GaborWeilTest) {σ₁ σ₂ τ B C c : ℝ},
  σ₁ ≤ σ₂ →
    0 ≤ B →
      0 ≤ C →
        0 ≤ c →
          (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, ↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I ≠ 1) →
            (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, riemannZeta (↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I) ≠ 0) →
              (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, ‖logDeriv riemannZeta (↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤ B) →
                (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, ‖RH.gaborHat F (↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-c * τ ^ 2)) →
                  ‖∫ (x : ℝ) in σ₁..σ₂,
                        logDeriv riemannZeta (↑x + ↑τ * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑x + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤
                    (σ₂ - σ₁) * B * C * Real.exp (-c * τ ^ 2)

declarations.name: RH.norm_horizontal_logDeriv_hat_integral_le
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.FullWeilTest) {σ₁ σ₂ τ B : ℝ},
  σ₁ ≤ σ₂ →
    0 ≤ B →
      (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, ↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I ≠ 1) →
        (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, riemannZeta (↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I) ≠ 0) →
          (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, ‖logDeriv riemannZeta (↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤ B) →
            ∃ C,
              0 ≤ C ∧
                ‖∫ (x : ℝ) in σ₁..σ₂, logDeriv riemannZeta (↑x + ↑τ * Complex.I) * F.hat (↑x + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤
                  (σ₂ - σ₁) * B * C / (1 + τ ^ 2)

declarations.name: RH.norm_horizontal_logDeriv_hat_integral_le_with
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.FullWeilTest) {σ₁ σ₂ τ B C : ℝ},
  σ₁ ≤ σ₂ →
    0 ≤ B →
      0 ≤ C →
        (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, ↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I ≠ 1) →
          (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, riemannZeta (↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I) ≠ 0) →
            (∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂, ‖logDeriv riemannZeta (↑σ + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤ B) →
              (∀ (s : ℂ), s.re ∈ Set.Icc σ₁ σ₂ → ‖F.hat s‖ ≤ C / (1 + s.im ^ 2)) →
                ‖∫ (x : ℝ) in σ₁..σ₂, logDeriv riemannZeta (↑x + ↑τ * Complex.I) * F.hat (↑x + ↑τ * Complex.I)‖ ≤
                  (σ₂ - σ₁) * B * C / (1 + τ ^ 2)

declarations.name: RH.norm_intervalIntegral_le_length_mul
declarations.type:

      (∀ (x : ℝ), a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ‖f x‖ ≤ C) → ‖∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f x‖ ≤ (b - a) * C

declarations.name: RH.norm_landauPoly_ge_on_mid_sphere
declarations.type:
∀ {T R : ℝ} {w : ℂ},
  w ∈ Metric.sphere (2 + ↑T * Complex.I) R →
    (∀ ρ ∈ RH.landauInnerDisk T, 1 / (32 * (↑(RH.landauInnerDisk T).card + 1)) ≤ |R - ‖ρ - (2 + ↑T * Complex.I)‖|) →

declarations.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ

declarations.name: RH.pureGaborHatDelta.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (a omega : ℝ) (δ : ℂ),
  RH.pureGaborHatDelta a omega δ =
    ↑(Real.pi / (4 * a)) *
      (↑(Real.exp ((δ.re ^ 2 - (δ.im + omega) ^ 2) / (2 * a))) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑δ.re * (↑δ.im + ↑omega) / ↑a)) +
          ↑(Real.exp ((δ.re ^ 2 - (δ.im - omega) ^ 2) / (2 * a))) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑δ.re * (↑δ.im - ↑omega) / ↑a)) +
        2 * ↑(Real.exp ((δ.re ^ 2 - δ.im ^ 2 - omega ^ 2) / (2 * a))) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑δ.re * ↑δ.im / ↑a)))

declarations.name: RH.pureGaborHatDelta_eq_holomorphic

declarations.name: RH.pureGaborHatDelta_one_zero
declarations.type:
∀ (δ : ℂ),
  RH.pureGaborHatDelta 1 0 δ =
    ↑Real.pi * ↑(Real.exp ((δ.re ^ 2 - δ.im ^ 2) / 2)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑(δ.re * δ.im))

declarations.name: RH.pureGaborHatHolomorphic.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (a omega : ℝ) (δ : ℂ),
  RH.pureGaborHatHolomorphic a omega δ =
    ↑(Real.pi / (4 * a)) *
      (Complex.exp ((δ + Complex.I * ↑omega) ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a)) + Complex.exp ((δ - Complex.I * ↑omega) ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a)) +
        2 * Complex.exp (-↑omega ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a)) * Complex.exp (δ ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a)))

declarations.name: RH.pureGaborHatHolomorphic_eq_delta
declarations.type: ∀ (a omega : ℝ), 0 < a → ∀ (δ : ℂ), RH.pureGaborHatHolomorphic a omega δ = RH.pureGaborHatDelta a omega δ

declarations.name: RH.pureGaborHatHolomorphic_neg

declarations.name: RH.pureGabor_integral_closed_form
declarations.type:
∀ (a omega : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    ∀ (z : ℂ),
      ∫ (u : ℝ),
          ↑(√(Real.pi / (2 * a)) / 2 * Real.exp (-a * u ^ 2 / 2) *
                (Real.cos (omega * u) + Real.exp (-omega ^ 2 / (2 * a)))) *
            Complex.exp (z * ↑u) =
        ↑(Real.pi / (4 * a)) *
          (↑(Real.exp ((z.re ^ 2 - (z.im + omega) ^ 2) / (2 * a))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑z.re * (↑z.im + ↑omega) / ↑a)) +
              ↑(Real.exp ((z.re ^ 2 - (z.im - omega) ^ 2) / (2 * a))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑z.re * (↑z.im - ↑omega) / ↑a)) +
            2 * ↑(Real.exp ((z.re ^ 2 - z.im ^ 2 - omega ^ 2) / (2 * a))) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑z.re * ↑z.im / ↑a)))

declarations.name: RH.pureGabor_integral_compact
declarations.type:
∀ (a omega : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    ∀ (z : ℂ),
      ∫ (u : ℝ),
          ↑(√(Real.pi / (2 * a)) / 2 * Real.exp (-a * u ^ 2 / 2) *
                (Real.cos (omega * u) + Real.exp (-omega ^ 2 / (2 * a)))) *
            Complex.exp (z * ↑u) =
        ↑(Real.pi / (4 * a)) *
          (Complex.exp ((z + Complex.I * ↑omega) ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a)) +
              Complex.exp ((z - Complex.I * ↑omega) ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a)) +
            2 * Complex.exp (-↑omega ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a)) * Complex.exp (z ^ 2 / (2 * ↑a)))

declarations.name: RH.rankOne_inertia_antitone
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ),
  A.IsHermitian →
    RH.indNeg (A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v) ≤ RH.indNeg A ∧ RH.indNeg A ≤ RH.indNeg (A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v) + 1

declarations.name: RH.rankOne_inertia_antitone._proof_1_2
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (V : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)),
  Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).range ≤ Module.finrank ℝ ℝ →
    Module.finrank ℝ ℝ = 1 → ¬Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).range ≤ 1 → False

declarations.name: RH.rankOne_inertia_antitone._proof_1_3
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (V : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)),
  Module.finrank ℝ ↥V = sigNeg A.toQuadraticMap' →
    Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).range + Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).ker =
        Module.finrank ℝ ↥V →
      Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).range ≤ 1 →
        ¬Module.finrank ℝ ↥V ≤ Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).ker + 1 → False

declarations.name: RH.rankOne_inertia_antitone._proof_1_5
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (V : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)),
  Module.finrank ℝ ↥V = sigNeg A.toQuadraticMap' →
    Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).range + Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).ker =
        Module.finrank ℝ ↥V →
      Module.finrank ℝ ↥V ≤ Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).ker + 1 →
        Module.finrank ℝ ↥(RH.coordDot v ∘ₗ V.subtype).ker = Module.finrank ℝ ↥(V ⊓ (RH.coordDot v).ker) →
          Module.finrank ℝ ↥(V ⊓ (RH.coordDot v).ker) ≤ sigNeg (A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).toQuadraticMap' →
            ¬sigNeg A.toQuadraticMap' ≤ sigNeg (A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).toQuadraticMap' + 1 → False

declarations.name: RH.re_digamma_weierstrass_Ioo
declarations.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 1 < x → x < 2 → (↑x).digamma.re = -Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + ∑' (n : ℕ), (1 / (↑n + 1) - 1 / (↑n + x))

declarations.name: RH.re_gaborHat_exposed_le
declarations.type:

  (RH.gaborHat (RH.pureGaborTest (RH.exposedPhaseLockA E n) E.omega ⋯) ↑E.ρ).re ≤
    -(Real.pi / (4 * RH.exposedPhaseLockA E n)) * Real.exp (E.M / (2 * RH.exposedPhaseLockA E n)) +
      3 * Real.pi / (4 * RH.exposedPhaseLockA E n) * Real.exp ((E.M - E.Δ) / (2 * RH.exposedPhaseLockA E n))

declarations.name: RH.re_logDeriv_primitive_eq
declarations.type:
∀ {f h : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {R : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R, f z ≠ 0) →
        h c = 0 →
          (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R, HasDerivAt h (logDeriv f z) z) →
            ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ Metric.ball c R → (h z).re = Real.log ‖f z‖ - Real.log ‖f c‖

declarations.name: RH.re_ofReal_mul_cexp_I

declarations.name: RH.re_of_mem_reProdIm
declarations.type: ∀ {z w s : ℂ}, z.re ≤ w.re → s ∈ Set.uIcc z.re w.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z.im w.im → z.re ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ w.re

declarations.name: RH.re_pureGaborHatDelta
declarations.type:
∀ (a omega : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    ∀ (δ : ℂ),
      (RH.pureGaborHatDelta a omega δ).re =
        Real.pi / (4 * a) *
          (Real.exp ((δ.re ^ 2 - (δ.im + omega) ^ 2) / (2 * a)) * Real.cos (δ.re * (δ.im + omega) / a) +
              Real.exp ((δ.re ^ 2 - (δ.im - omega) ^ 2) / (2 * a)) * Real.cos (δ.re * (δ.im - omega) / a) +
            2 * Real.exp ((δ.re ^ 2 - δ.im ^ 2 - omega ^ 2) / (2 * a)) * Real.cos (δ.re * δ.im / a))

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral
declarations.type: (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ),
  RH.rectangleIntegral f z w =
    (((∫ (x : ℝ) in z.re..w.re, f (↑x + ↑z.im * Complex.I)) - ∫ (x : ℝ) in z.re..w.re, f (↑x + ↑w.im * Complex.I)) +
        Complex.I • ∫ (y : ℝ) in z.im..w.im, f (↑w.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) -
      Complex.I • ∫ (y : ℝ) in z.im..w.im, f (↑z.re + ↑y * Complex.I)

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_add
declarations.type:
∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ),
  IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f (↑x + ↑z.im * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume z.re w.re →
    IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f (↑x + ↑w.im * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume z.re w.re →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun y => f (↑w.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume z.im w.im →
        IntervalIntegrable (fun y => f (↑z.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume z.im w.im →
          IntervalIntegrable (fun x => g (↑x + ↑z.im * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume z.re w.re →
            IntervalIntegrable (fun x => g (↑x + ↑w.im * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume z.re w.re →
              IntervalIntegrable (fun y => g (↑w.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume z.im w.im →
                IntervalIntegrable (fun y => g (↑z.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume z.im w.im →
                  RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => f ζ + g ζ) z w =
                    RH.rectangleIntegral f z w + RH.rectangleIntegral g z w

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_arch_fe_hat
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.GaborWeilTest) {T : ℝ},
  0 < T →
    RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor ζ * RH.gaborHat F ζ) (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑(-T) * Complex.I)
        (↑(1 / 2) + ↑T * Complex.I) =
      2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * -RH.gaborHat F 0

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_arch_fe_hat_unfold
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.GaborWeilTest) (T : ℝ),
  RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor ζ * RH.gaborHat F ζ) (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑(-T) * Complex.I)
      (↑(1 / 2) + ↑T * Complex.I) =
    (((∫ (x : ℝ) in -1 / 16..1 / 2,
            logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor (↑x + ↑(-T) * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑x + ↑(-T) * Complex.I)) -
          ∫ (x : ℝ) in -1 / 16..1 / 2,
            logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor (↑x + ↑T * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑x + ↑T * Complex.I)) +
        Complex.I •
          ∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T,
            logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor (↑(1 / 2) + ↑y * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑(1 / 2) + ↑y * Complex.I)) -
      Complex.I •
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T,
          logDeriv RH.zetaFEFactor (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑y * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑y * Complex.I)

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_comp_add
declarations.type: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z w p : ℂ), RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => f (ζ + p)) (z - p) (w - p) = RH.rectangleIntegral f z w

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_comp_sub
declarations.type: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z w p : ℂ), RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => f (ζ - p)) z w = RH.rectangleIntegral f (z - p) (w - p)

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_congr_sides
declarations.type:
∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ),
  Set.EqOn (fun x => f (↑x + ↑z.im * Complex.I)) (fun x => g (↑x + ↑z.im * Complex.I)) (Set.uIcc z.re w.re) →
    Set.EqOn (fun x => f (↑x + ↑w.im * Complex.I)) (fun x => g (↑x + ↑w.im * Complex.I)) (Set.uIcc z.re w.re) →
      Set.EqOn (fun y => f (↑w.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) (fun y => g (↑w.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) (Set.uIcc z.im w.im) →
        Set.EqOn (fun y => f (↑z.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) (fun y => g (↑z.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) (Set.uIcc z.im w.im) →
          RH.rectangleIntegral f z w = RH.rectangleIntegral g z w

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_const_mul
declarations.type: ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ), RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => c * f ζ) z w = c * RH.rectangleIntegral f z w

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_const_mul._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_9} [inst : Mul α] (a b : α), a * b = a • b

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_div_sub
declarations.type:
∀ (z w p r : ℂ),
  z.re < p.re →
    p.re < w.re →
      z.im < p.im → p.im < w.im → RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => r / (ζ - p)) z w = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * r

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn
declarations.type:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ),
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Set.uIcc z.re w.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z.im w.im) → RH.rectangleIntegral f z w = 0

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_inv_of_mem
declarations.type:
∀ (z w p : ℂ),
  z.re < p.re →
    p.re < w.re → z.im < p.im → p.im < w.im → RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => (ζ - p)⁻¹) z w = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_inv_of_zero_mem
declarations.type:
∀ (z w : ℂ),
  z.re < 0 → 0 < w.re → z.im < 0 → 0 < w.im → RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => ζ⁻¹) z w = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_logDeriv_gaborHat
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.GaborWeilTest) (T : ℝ),
  RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => logDeriv riemannZeta ζ * RH.gaborHat F ζ) (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑(-T) * Complex.I)
      (↑2 + ↑T * Complex.I) =
    (((∫ (x : ℝ) in -1 / 16..2,
            logDeriv riemannZeta (↑x + ↑(-T) * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑x + ↑(-T) * Complex.I)) -
          ∫ (x : ℝ) in -1 / 16..2, logDeriv riemannZeta (↑x + ↑T * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑x + ↑T * Complex.I)) +
        Complex.I •
          ∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T, logDeriv riemannZeta (2 + ↑y * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (2 + ↑y * Complex.I)) -
      Complex.I •
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T,
          logDeriv riemannZeta (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑y * Complex.I) * RH.gaborHat F (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑y * Complex.I)

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_logDeriv_hat
declarations.type:
∀ (F : RH.FullWeilTest) (T : ℝ),
  RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => logDeriv riemannZeta ζ * F.hat ζ) (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑(-T) * Complex.I)
      (↑2 + ↑T * Complex.I) =
    (((∫ (x : ℝ) in -1 / 16..2, logDeriv riemannZeta (↑x + ↑(-T) * Complex.I) * F.hat (↑x + ↑(-T) * Complex.I)) -
          ∫ (x : ℝ) in -1 / 16..2, logDeriv riemannZeta (↑x + ↑T * Complex.I) * F.hat (↑x + ↑T * Complex.I)) +
        Complex.I • ∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T, logDeriv riemannZeta (2 + ↑y * Complex.I) * F.hat (2 + ↑y * Complex.I)) -
      Complex.I •
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T, logDeriv riemannZeta (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑y * Complex.I) * F.hat (↑(-1 / 16) + ↑y * Complex.I)

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_simple_pole
declarations.type:
∀ (h : ℂ → ℂ) (z w p r : ℂ),
  DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Set.uIcc z.re w.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z.im w.im) →
    z.re < p.re →
      p.re < w.re →
        z.im < p.im → p.im < w.im → RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => r / (ζ - p) + h ζ) z w = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * r

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_sum_div
declarations.type:
∀ (s : Finset ℂ) (r : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ),
  (∀ p ∈ s, z.re < p.re ∧ p.re < w.re ∧ z.im < p.im ∧ p.im < w.im) →
    RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => ∑ p ∈ s, r p / (ζ - p)) z w = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ∑ p ∈ s, r p

declarations.name: RH.rectangleIntegral_sum_simple_poles
declarations.type:
∀ (h : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ) (s : Finset ℂ) (r : ℂ → ℂ),
  DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Set.uIcc z.re w.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z.im w.im) →
    (∀ p ∈ s, z.re < p.re ∧ p.re < w.re ∧ z.im < p.im ∧ p.im < w.im) →
      RH.rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => ∑ p ∈ s, r p / (ζ - p) + h ζ) z w = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ∑ p ∈ s, r p

declarations.name: RH.rectangle_inv_arctan_sum
declarations.type:
∀ {α β γ Γ : ℝ},
  α < 0 →
    0 < β →
      γ < 0 →
        0 < Γ →
          -(Real.arctan (β / γ) - Real.arctan (α / γ)) + (Real.arctan (β / Γ) - Real.arctan (α / Γ)) +
                (Real.arctan (Γ / β) - Real.arctan (γ / β)) -
              (Real.arctan (Γ / α) - Real.arctan (γ / α)) =
            2 * Real.pi

declarations.type:

  [inst_3 : DecidableEq l] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (B : Matrix n l ℝ) (D : Matrix l l ℝ),
  A.IsHermitian →
    ∀ [Invertible A],
      have T := Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (-(A⁻¹ * B)) 0 1;
      have S := D - B.transpose * (A⁻¹ * B);
      T.det = 1 ∧ T.transpose * Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.transpose D * T = Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 S

  [inst_3 : DecidableEq l] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (B : Matrix n l ℝ) (D : Matrix l l ℝ),
  D.IsHermitian →
    ∀ [Invertible D],
      have T := Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 (-(D⁻¹ * B.transpose)) 1;
      have S := A - B * (D⁻¹ * B.transpose);
      T.det = 1 ∧ T.transpose * Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.transpose D * T = Matrix.fromBlocks S 0 0 D

∀ (f : { z // RH.IsCriticalStripZetaZero z } → ℂ) {ρ : { z // RH.IsCriticalStripZetaZero z }},
  RH.stripSigma ρ ≠ 0 →
    RH.stripGamma ρ ≠ 0 →
      ∑ τ ∈ RH.stripOrbitFinset ρ, f τ =
        f ρ + f (RH.stripStarEquiv ρ) + f (RH.stripFEEquiv ρ) + f (RH.stripOrbitEquiv ρ)

  F.coeffs = { c0 := 1, c2 := 0, c4 := 0 } →
    ∀ {ρ : { z // RH.IsCriticalStripZetaZero z }},
      RH.stripSigma ρ ≠ 0 →
        RH.stripGamma ρ ≠ 0 →
          ∑ τ ∈ RH.stripOrbitFinset ρ, ↑(RH.riemannZetaMultiplicity ↑τ) * RH.gaborHat F ↑τ =
            4 * ↑(RH.riemannZetaMultiplicity ↑ρ) * ↑(RH.gaborHat F ↑ρ).re

        ρ ≠ RH.stripFEEquiv ρ ∧

            RH.stripStarEquiv ρ ≠ RH.stripFEEquiv ρ ∧

declarations.name: RH.threeLobe_finset_le_logMajorant_of_summable
declarations.type:
∀ {a omega : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    ∀ (S : Finset ℝ),
      (∀ (k : ℤ), ↑{t ∈ S | ↑k < t ∧ t ≤ ↑k + 1}.card ≤ RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k) →
        (Summable fun k => RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k * RH.gaussBinMax a omega k) →
          (Summable fun k => RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k * RH.gaussBinMax a (-omega) k) →
            (Summable fun k => RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k * RH.gaussBinMax a 0 k) →
              S.sum (RH.gaborThreeLobe a omega) ≤ RH.gaborLogThreeLobeMajorant a omega

declarations.name: RH.threeLobe_from_half_rate
declarations.type:
∀ (a omega t σ' : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    Real.exp ((σ' ^ 2 - (t + omega) ^ 2) / (4 * a)) ^ 2 + Real.exp ((σ' ^ 2 - (t - omega) ^ 2) / (4 * a)) ^ 2 +
        2 * (Real.exp ((σ' ^ 2 - (t + omega) ^ 2) / (4 * a)) * Real.exp ((σ' ^ 2 - (t - omega) ^ 2) / (4 * a))) =
      Real.exp (σ' ^ 2 / (2 * a)) * RH.gaborThreeLobe a omega t

  0 < a →

      (Summable fun k => RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k * RH.gaussBinMax a omega k) →
        (Summable fun k => RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k * RH.gaussBinMax a (-omega) k) →
          (Summable fun k => RH.gaborBinCountMajorant k * RH.gaussBinMax a 0 k) →
            ∑ ρ ∈ S, ↑(RH.riemannZetaMultiplicity ↑ρ) * RH.gaborThreeLobe a omega (↑ρ).im ≤
              RH.gaborLogThreeLobeMajorant a omega

declarations.type:

declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℕ → Type u_2} [inst : (m : ℕ) → Fintype (κ m)] [inst_1 : (m : ℕ) → DecidableEq (κ m)]
  (T : TfptCarrier.SectorPositiveDescent.DescentTower κ) (ρ : ℕ → (m : ℕ) → Matrix (κ m) (κ m) ℝ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), TfptCarrier.SectorPositiveDescent.IsCompatibleFamily T (ρ n)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), TfptCarrier.SectorPositiveDescent.IsPositiveFamily (ρ n)) →
      ∀ (G : Matrix (κ 0) (κ 0) ℝ),
        (∀ (i j : κ 0),
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => TfptCarrier.SectorPositiveDescent.corner (T.e 0) (ρ n 0) i j) Filter.atTop
              (𝓝 (G i j))) →
          ∀ (identified : Matrix (κ 0) (κ 0) ℝ → ℝ),
            TfptCarrier.SectorPositiveDescent.IdentificationPositivity identified G →
              (∀ (n : ℕ),
                  TfptCarrier.SectorPositiveDescent.IsCompatibleFamily T
                    (TfptCarrier.SectorPositiveDescent.cornerFamily T (ρ n))) ∧
                (∀ (n : ℕ),
                    TfptCarrier.SectorPositiveDescent.IsPositiveFamily
                      (TfptCarrier.SectorPositiveDescent.cornerFamily T (ρ n))) ∧
                  G.PosSemidef ∧ (∀ (x : κ 0 → ℝ), 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ G.mulVec x) ∧ 0 ≤ identified G
